crossRefs.note: He said to them, “Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this…
Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, “Behold, if Yahweh made windows in…
If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.
When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a…

translations.web: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.
translations.bsb: But their words seemed like nonsense to them, and they did not believe the women.
translations.kjv: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
translations.asv: And these words appeared in their sight as idle talk; and they disbelieved them.
